title: feat(app-shell): the environment list offers only "Set up your production environment"; the development-environment door is gone
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HP?thread=cmsg_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HPLuovszPmhavRYXixiYVakP)_

Part of #29770. This PR implements the whole card. The card is closed by hand when this PR lands: the executing branch is a project-thread branch, not `claude/issue-<n>-*`, and the closing-target guard only accepts a claim that names the latter shape.

## What changes

Card B of the objectstack-ai/cloud#3487 ruling D ([ruling of record](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/3487#issuecomment-6595099217)): each organization has exactly one environment, its production environment, and the development type is retired. All changes are under `ui/packages/app-shell` and `ui/packages/i18n`.

- **Toolbar (`EnvironmentListToolbar`).** "Set up your production environment" is the only creation path. `decideEnvironmentCta` now answers `setup_production` or `production_exists`. In `production_exists` the `create_environment` action is withheld: no "Add development environment" button, no plan-locked "Development environments · Team plan and up" mark (`DevelopmentLockedMark` is deleted), no dialog, no POST. Other toolbar actions render as before. The `?runAction=create_environment` deep link is consumed and runs nothing in that state, the same handling the retired plan-locked state had. The loading skeleton and the no-signal fallback (metadata label + dialog safety net) are unchanged.
- **Dialog (`entitlementDialogFromError`).** Maps `PRODUCTION_ENV_LIMIT` only. The `DEV_ENV_PLAN_LOCKED` / `DEV_ENV_LIMIT` branches and `planPhrase` are deleted. Those codes and cloud card A's new `DEV_ENV_RETIRED` take the ordinary error path and show the server's own message.
- **State.** `EnvironmentEntitlementsState.canCreateDevelopmentEnv` and `EnvironmentEntitlementsSummary.development` are removed. None of these types is exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`.
- **i18n.** Removed from all ten locale bundles: `planTier.teamAndUp` (and the `planTier` namespace), `environment.addDevelopment`, `environment.developmentLocked`, `environment.entitlement.{planLockedTitle, planLockedBody, limitTitle, limitBody, limitBodyWithCount, freePlan, namedPlan, upgradeCta}`. The ADR-0060 live list `product-specific.allowlist.json` shrinks by the same keys. It accepts deletions only, and this PR only deletes.

## Why

The control plane is closing its development doors in parallel (cloud card A, objectstack-ai/cloud#3501, `DEV_ENV_RETIRED`). Without this change, a Console showing "Add development environment" would only produce refusals. Cloud's next framework pin carries this PR, and cloud card D (objectstack-ai/cloud#3503) waits for that pin.

**Acceptance notes.**
- An organization that already owns its environment, in the **no-signal** state (summary endpoint and row derivation both failed), still sees the metadata-labelled create button, as before. A POST there gets the control plane's answer. If that answer is `PRODUCTION_ENV_LIMIT`, the limit dialog opens. If it is `DEV_ENV_RETIRED`, a toast shows the server's localized sentence. Which code cloud returns for a typeless create once production exists is cloud card A's call.
- `classifyEnvironmentType` in `useEnvironmentEntitlements` still mirrors the server's two types for the row fallback. It only decides `hasProductionEnv`, and archived rows are filtered out. Cloud card D retires the type end to end.

## Verification

- New pins: `EnvironmentListToolbar.test.tsx` › "no development-environment door renders (cloud#3487 D)" renders nine entitlement states (loading, no signal, no production / production × summary / rows × manager / member × free / team) in `en` and `zh`. Each asserts that no text matches `/development/i` (`开发环境` in zh) and that the retired locked-mark test id is absent. `entitlements.test.ts` and `useConsoleActionRuntime.test.tsx` pin `DEV_ENV_PLAN_LOCKED` / `DEV_ENV_LIMIT` / `DEV_ENV_RETIRED` to the ordinary error path, with no dialog.
- Production path unchanged: the setup-production label, primary variant, deep-link `autoTrigger` and skeleton pins are kept. The overflow deep-link pin (#4162) now runs on `setup_production`, using fillers with `order: -1` so the create action still overflows.
- Local run at `ebe16a4c` (objectstack-ai/objectstack): `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/environment/ packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useConsoleActionRuntime.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useConsoleActionRuntime.apiActionDoor-27611.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts packages/i18n/` → 106 files passed; 1634 tests passed, 13 skipped. `eslint --quiet` on the touched files is clean. The whole UI suite and type check ran in CI on the same head: all 16 Test UI shards, Type Check UI and Lint UI passed.
